notesHTML: • Control Mezzanine from the Plex app on your phone or from Plex Web: Mezzanine shows up as a player on your network. Pick it to play a title on the Mac, then pause, seek, skip and change audio or subtitles from the phone. Settings ▸ Playback has the switch. The phone and the Mac need to reach each other on the network (some routers keep Wi-Fi devices apart).
